## Steps for inviting Dr. Hansen to lunch

1. Request an available lunch slot [here](https://calendar.app.google/LDGK5knLTJibfL9S9).
2. Wait for confirmation email from Dr. Hansen.
3. Complete the [online form](https://app.smartsheet.com/b/form/50e26a99eca44ec9a421cb2bfdad151a) for WCSA.
4. Meet Dr. Hansen at the DC at the scheduled time!
